$comment: The committed registry of the public share-link states (JRNY-08, plan 12-07). All three are session none: the share view is the product's ONLY anonymous surface, and driving it signed-in would prove nothing about what an anonymous visitor sees. share-populated and share-uncomputed drive the SAME Alpha token and differ purely by the reset each declares -- case-alpha-computed runs the real engine at run time to give the case an output_json, case-alpha-no-output takes it away again. No engine result is committed as SQL; check-seed-fixture.mjs rejects that with SEED WRITES OUTPUT. share-disabled drives the Beta token, whose share_enabled is false. The DOM half of 'exposes only what it should' lives in the rubrics as no-actions-bar, content-absent and heir-table-absent; the data half is gate G20, journey/share-exposure.mjs.
